scope.detail: Seven files inside the pinned lock, plus this lane's own manifest, .ops/sync file and proof bundle. THREE files are outside it and are declared above rather than left to be discovered: adding a live-DB proof has two mandatory registration points, neither of which lives under apps/api/src, and admitting the second of those into the runtime lane's allowlist is the third. A file_scope_lock is pinned at lane-start and cannot be widened by an agent, so these need a CODEOWNERS scope-override/v1; the non-required 'File scope lock' check reporting them is a correct check reporting a real scope question, not a defective one. No workflow, no merge control, no branch protection, no containment setting, no deploy path and no migration is touched.

out_of_scope_files.package.json: Wires the new t1-proof suite into `test:t1-proof:live`. `pnpm verify` fails closed with WIRING_TEST_UNWIRED_NEW on any test file unreachable from a package script, and this is the only wiring point for a live-DB proof.
out_of_scope_files.docs/05_operations/db-writer-classificat: Registers the new suite as a credentialed DB test with owner `api` and its single executing command. `verify`'s 'Enforce DB writer classification' step fails closed without it.
out_of_scope_files..lane/lanes/runtime.yml: Admits docs/05_operations/db-writer-classification.json into the runtime lane's allowed_path_globs as one exact file. Without it `Lane authority` fails with `outside_allowed_paths` and no runtime lane can legally carry its own live-DB proof. Allowlist admission correction only -- no taxonomy change, no executor-policy change, no change to any required check.

limits: The live proof exercises the manual coverage-gap branch only. The structured team-fallback branch is NOT proven against a live database: doing so needs a canonical team catalog with coverage on exactly one side of a matchup, and populating one is reference-data seeding under a reserved provider decision. That branch is proven in process and by mutation control 2.

This lane does not prove Milestone 1 step 4 end to end. It removes the API-side refusal that blocked it and proves the persistence and non-delivery halves against staging. Reaching the deployed form, authenticating as griff843 and submitting a real pick remain a separate run against the deployed system.

The proof is against STAGING, not production. `assert-staging-target.ts` pins the target to xskgrzbteyqdufktjrjx and the job holds no production credential. Nothing here establishes production behaviour beyond the fact that it is the same code.

The non-required 'Shadow Parity Check' is red because no mechanically read-only production credential is provisioned; it refuses service-role credentials by design, so it compared nothing and reached no parity conclusion. Provisioning that credential is a reserved secrets decision.

The non-required 'Return review packet' is red on scope bleed naming this bundle's own diff-summary.md and verification.md, both written by ops:proof-generate into this lane's proof directory. expected_proof_paths is settable only at manifest create and sameIssueLaneMetadataPaths carries no proof glob (pr-review-packet.ts:487-491).
